reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: accrue_interest has multiple non-test callers (market.move:274, 459, 578, 647, 884, 901, 919). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is untrusted public lending operations. Gate 3: market.move is in scope and interest rate manipulation is a listed focus area. An attacker can trigger this via normal lending operations (borrow/repay/liquidate) by simply using the protocol, causing accrue_interest (market.move:1025) to pass repay_fee_rate instead of a dedicated reserve_factor, resulting in the protocol treasury receiving ~100x less than the designed reserve factor allocation on every interest accrual.
